root_cause: Media identity, duration, URL, freshness and channel rotation checks did not establish pedagogical substance or proportion of AI content. Publisher promotional content and tangentially AI-related general news could qualify.

prevention.video: Reject product launch films, trailers, product advertisements and marketing demonstrations with insufficient transferable teaching. Require source-grounded learning objectives, at least three concrete independently useful substantive ideas or a demonstrated reusable procedure, and a usefulness review based on timestamped content/transcript/chapter evidence (not product-page copy alone). Favor short 5-10 minute explainers; 10-20 minute fallback needs explicit justification.
prevention.podcast: At least 75% of substantive editorial episode runtime must be AI or practical AI workflow discussion, supported by whole-episode agenda/transcript/timestamps; exclude ad reads from numerator. Multi-topic general-news digests containing a brief AI segment are rejected.
prevention.verification: Content-reviewed and playback-verified remain separate booleans; metadata/channel/episode facts never substitute for usefulness evidence. No claim of complete viewing/listening without such evidence.
prevention.constraints: Preserve 2 videos, 2 podcasts, category diversity, historical uniqueness, exact URLs, sealed original source bundle, source job, approved PNGs, Oct8 objects and zero paid API. Corrections require protected PR and actual live verification.
